_notes: This is the plan prepare_images.py lays into the backend's upload slots; slot counts and crop rules come from profile.image.trays, never from this file.
variants[] is what the per-SKU slot binds to: each entry needs a label (shown in the SKU row) and a src file.
main fills with variants first then scenes; detail puts the infographic first when the plan names one, then variants, then scenes. Both are truncated to the tray's maxCount.
trays.<key> given explicitly (even as null) overrides the automatic order for that slot - use it when the user says which images go where.
single means one image, nothing added: no padding, no repeats, no invented slots.
A short set is reported as short with the missing count and never filled by repeating an image; the same file twice in one slot group is an error.
